assignment_notes.Gender Equality: Gender only: demographic signal, NOT a measure of equality. Pay and career outcomes are audited separately by gender, not duplicated as predictors.
assignment_notes.Department: Organisational context assigned to working conditions; could also reflect career opportunities.
assignment_notes.DistanceFromHome: Residential profile; also relevant to working conditions. Assignment sensitivity is reported.
assignment_notes.EnvironmentSatisfaction: Work environment assigned to working conditions rather than engagement.
assignment_notes.JobRole: Career position; also proxies working conditions and compensation.
assignment_notes.PerformanceRating: Career assessment; may also affect pay.
assignment_notes.DailyRate / HourlyRate / MonthlyRate: Kept under compensation, but definitions and comparability with income are undocumented.
assignment_notes.Gender: Existing Female=1, Male=0 coding retained; no broader gender categories are available.
